He played [[college basketball]] for the [[UConn Huskies men's basketball|UConn Huskies]]. He was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the top players in the 2024 class. ==Early life and high school career== McNeeley grew up in [[Richardson, Texas]] and initially attended [[J. J. Pearce High School]].{{Cite web |last=Insight |first=Pro |date=November 30, 2020 |title=Liam McNeeley Q&A |url=https://www.prospectiveinsight.com/post/liam-mcneeley |access-date=January 17, 2025 web|url=https://www.dallasnews.com/high-school-sports/basketball/2022/06/02/john-paul-ii-five-star-recruit-liam-mcneeley-transfers-to-montverde-academy-fla/|title=John Paul II five-star recruit Liam Interscholastic Basketball Conference (NIBC) competition in his first season at Montverde.{{cite web|url=https://www.kansascity.com/sports/college/big-12/university-of-kansas/article278709894.html|title=KU basketball recruiting: Liam McNeeley will visit Jayhawks|work=[[The Kansas City McNeeley was selected to play in the [[2024 McDonald's All-American Boys Game]] during his senior year.{{cite web|url=https://www.dallasnews.com/high-school-sports/basketball/2024/01/23/texas-signee-tre-johnson-liam-mcneeley-make-2024-mcdonalds-all-american-game-rosters/|title=Tre Johnson, Liam McNeeley make |access-date=July 8, 2025 |work=CT Insider |url-status=live }} Three days later, McNeeley recorded 10 points and 11 rebounds against [[New Hampshire Wildcats men's basketball|New Hampshire]], becoming the first freshman to log back-to-back double-doubles since [[Corny Thompson]] in 1978.{{Cite magazine |date=November 11, 2024 |title=UConn Freshman Wing Becomes First Husky Since 1978 To Accomplish Illustrated]]}} On November 17, McNeeley earned [[Big East Conference|Big East]] Freshman of the Week honors for his 15-point performance in a 90–49 victory over [[Le Moyne Dolphins men's basketball|Le Moyne]].{{Cite web |title=Liam McNeeley Named BIG EAST Freshman of the Week |url=https://uconnhuskies.com/news/2024/11/18/mens-basketball-liam-mcneeley-named-big-east-freshman-of-the-week |access-date=July 8, 2025 |website=University of Connecticut Athletics}}{{Cite magazine leading the Huskies to a 2–0 week, he was named Big East Freshman of the Week again on December 9, sharing the honor with teammate [[Alex Karaban]].{{Cite web |title=McNeeley and Karaban Earn BIG EAST assists. was selected with the 29th pick by the [[Phoenix Suns]] in the [[2025 NBA draft]].
